## Checklist (definition of done — see docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] New logic in `src/sim`, `src/core` or `src/audio/theory.ts` has unit tests
- [ ] Ran it and looked: no console errors or warnings at the times above
- [ ] Non-negotiables in `CLAUDE.md` respected (code-only art, palette, no fail states, no teleporting, transactions, determinism, fictional specificity, 60 fps)
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is stated above
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or architecture changed
